prompt: Write a pandas check that reports null counts and duplicate row counts per column group before a model-training job starts. Make the check return a clear nonzero failure when a required column is entirely null.
A CSV has a label column encoded as strings with inconsistent capitalization and surrounding whitespace. Normalize the labels, report unknown values, and add a compact unit test for the normalizer.
Design dataset versioning for training runs when source files may be replaced in place. Describe how to record immutable inputs, schema version, preprocessing code revision, and checksums.

A training table joins user events to outcomes using a 30-day label window. Explain how to enforce an as-of cutoff so features never include events after the prediction time, and propose a leakage test.

Design a point-in-time feature dataset for delayed labels, late-arriving events, and backfilled source corrections. Define event time versus availability time, reproducible snapshots, and invariants that catch training-serving skew and future leakage.
Implement a scikit-learn pipeline that imputes numeric missing values and standardizes numeric columns while leaving a categorical column unchanged.
Create a train-fitted categorical encoder that handles unseen categories at inference. Explain why it must be fit only on the training partition and add a test for an unknown category.

A text classifier uses target encoding on a high-cardinality feature and gets implausibly strong validation results. Diagnose leakage risks and propose cross-fitting and time-aware validation where appropriate.

Design a feature pipeline shared between offline training and online inference with freshness requirements, backfills, schema changes, and rollback. Specify how parity is tested and how stale or unavailable features affect predictions.

A recommendation model uses user history and item popularity features, with heavy-tailed user activity and rapidly changing inventory. Propose a leakage-safe temporal feature design, offline/online computation split, and a migration plan that controls feature skew during rollout.
Add deterministic seeding for Python, NumPy, and a PyTorch CPU training loop, then explain the limits of expecting bitwise reproducibility.

Write a PyTorch training loop that clips gradient norms, clears gradients correctly, and stops after a configurable number of epochs. Include a testable checkpoint save condition based on validation loss.

Training loss becomes NaN only after mixed precision is enabled on one GPU type. Give a diagnostic sequence and propose safe fixes that preserve throughput where possible; distinguish numerical instability from bad input batches.

Plan a distributed training job for a model that barely fits across several GPUs. Compare data and tensor parallelism, checkpoint/restart behavior, communication bottlenecks, and how to verify that scaling improves time-to-quality rather than only throughput.

A large training run has intermittent worker loss, non-deterministic data sharding, and checkpoints that take longer than the recovery interval. Design a fault-tolerant training architecture with checkpoint consistency, shard resumption, elastic membership, and cost-aware recovery tests.
Compute precision, recall, and F1 from a confusion matrix in Python and return zero safely when a denominator is zero.
A binary classifier has a 1% positive rate. Explain why accuracy is misleading, choose two useful metrics, and show how to compute them from labels and probabilities.

A team tunes hyperparameters repeatedly against one validation set and reports its best score as an unbiased estimate. Explain the selection bias and propose a nested or otherwise defensible evaluation protocol with uncertainty reporting.

Design an evaluation plan for a ranking model when users and items overlap across time, feedback is position-biased, and offline gains may not translate online. Specify temporal splits, leakage checks, counterfactual analysis limits, and an online experiment with guardrails.

An offline benchmark improves substantially after dataset deduplication and a new prompt template, but historical comparisons used the old pipeline. Build a versioned evaluation system that tests data contamination, slice regressions, calibration, statistical uncertainty, and comparability across pipeline revisions.
Wrap a scikit-learn model with input schema validation and a JSON response containing the predicted class and model version.

A prediction endpoint has p99 latency spikes after a model update. List measurements that separate queueing, preprocessing, model inference, and serialization time, then suggest a low-risk profiling plan.
Design a canary deployment for a new model version with shadow traffic, schema compatibility, rollback triggers, and protection against comparing predictions on different request populations.

Design a high-throughput GPU inference service with dynamic batching, multiple model versions, strict tail-latency limits, autoscaling, and graceful degradation. Explain capacity tests, fairness between tenants, and rollback behavior.

A model service must support online features, GPU inference, regional failover, and regulated audit trails. Propose a serving architecture and rollout strategy that preserves feature/model compatibility, protects sensitive inputs, and supports reproducible incident analysis.
Add a structured log field for model_version to each prediction record and write a test that verifies it is present.

A scheduled retraining job should publish a model only if validation metrics pass configured thresholds. Describe the pipeline stages and implement a simple gate that records why a candidate was rejected.

Production feature distributions drift but aggregate model accuracy remains stable. Design drift monitoring that distinguishes data quality shifts, covariate drift, label shift, and concept drift; address delayed labels, alert fatigue, and retraining triggers.

Build a model registry and promotion workflow for teams that need lineage from source data and code to artifact, evaluation report, approval, deployment, and rollback. Address concurrent candidate runs and immutable audit history.

A regulated prediction system needs reproducible training, controlled data access, explainability records, monitoring, and emergency rollback across multiple regions. Design the operational lifecycle and define evidence retained at each transition from dataset approval to retirement.
